facts.text: The Champion course is home to the PGA Tour's Cognizant Classic and the Bear Trap, one of the most famed three-hole stretches in professional golf.
facts.excerpt: Home course of the PGA Tour’s Cognizant Classic and "The Bear Trap", one of the most famed — and toughest — three-hole stretches in professional golf.

facts.text: The Palmer course is named after its designer, Arnold Palmer.
facts.excerpt: Named after its legendary designer, Arnold Palmer, this is generally considered our most entertaining (and forgiving) course for all skill levels.

facts.text: The Wee Bear is a par 3 course with holes ranging from 60 to 130 yards.
facts.excerpt: With holes ranging from 60–130 yards, this par 3 course is perfect for experimenting with a variety of shots and is fun for players of all abilities.

facts.text: The Match course was designed with match play in mind.
facts.excerpt: Designed with match play in mind, The Match delivers a unique golf experience sure to appeal to purists, players and beginners alike.

facts.text: The resort has cottages designed by Serena & Lily.
facts.excerpt: twenty-one stunning Serena & Lily-designed cottages bring the coast to the greens in elevated leisure

facts.text: Each cottage is a two-bedroom, two-bath retreat with outdoor space.
facts.excerpt: Each two-bedroom, two-bath, 1,200 sq. ft., residentially-appointed retreat offers unsurpassed privacy and prestige, plus beautiful outdoor space.

facts.text: Each cottage sleeps up to six guests, or up to four guests for golf groups.
facts.excerpt: Sleeps up to six guests (up to 4 guests for golf groups)

facts.text: The cottages have a fully equipped kitchen and an en suite washer and dryer.
facts.excerpt:
- Fully Equipped Kitchen
- Outdoor Terrace
- Full-Sized Pull Out Sofa Bed
- En Suite Washer and Dryer

facts.text: Guestrooms have a private balcony or terrace, with options for views of the pool, gardens and grounds.
facts.excerpt: With a private balcony or terrace — and options for stunning views of the pool, gardens, and grounds of our Palm Beach golf resort

facts.text: Resort View rooms feature a tropical black and white wall mural, bold color nightstands and a pink pineapple lamp.
facts.excerpt: tropical black and white wall mural, bold color nightstands and media console, pink pineapple lamp, arc lamp

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has four balconies overlooking the pool and lake.
facts.excerpt: Four balconies overlook the pool and lake, with two walk-in closets providing ample space.

facts.text: The spa covers 40,000 square feet.
facts.excerpt: the expansive 40,000 sq ft reimagined spa

facts.text: The spa's signature Waters of the World experience features three mineral pools, including Dead Sea and Salies-de-Bearn pools, along with an outdoor hot tub.
facts.excerpt: the signature “Waters of the World” experience, featuring three mineral pools—including Dead Sea and Salies-de-Béarn pools—along with an outdoor hot tub for guided hot-and-cold contrast therapy

facts.text: The spa has steam rooms, a sauna and a Himalayan Salt Chamber.
facts.excerpt: Guests may integrate cryotherapy with the spa’s steam rooms, sauna, Himalayan Salt Chamber

facts.text: The spa has a NEO Luna whole-body cryotherapy chamber designed for single guests or couples.
facts.excerpt: electric whole-body cryotherapy chamber designed for single guests or couples. Cryotherapy serves as a powerful starting point

facts.text: The Spa at PGA National Resort is open to the public.
facts.excerpt: The Spa at PGA National Resort is open to the public.

facts.text: Spa services are available for guests aged 18 and older.
facts.excerpt: Services are available for guests aged 18 and older.

facts.text: The Sports & Racquet Club has 16 Har-Tru tennis courts, 12 new pickleball courts and 2 pop tennis courts.
facts.excerpt: With 16 Har-Tru tennis courts (11 lit for night play), 12 new pickleball and 2 pop tennis courts

facts.text: The resort keeps four on-site beehives with almost 250,000 honeybees and offers a behind-the-scenes beekeeping experience.
facts.excerpt: Home to almost 250,000 honeybees and their queens in four on-site hives, PGA National Resort presents a sweet-tastic behind-the-scenes experience to see the exquisite beauty of bees at work.

facts.text: The main resort pool is located in the heart of the resort.
facts.excerpt: Located in the heart of the resort, our main pool seamlessly blends relaxation and fun with signature South Florida flair.

facts.text: The resort has a kids club called Banyan Buddies Kids Club.
facts.excerpt: Banyan Buddies Kids Club

facts.text: A rare rock beach and natural beaches are a short drive from the resort, and the concierge can arrange transportation.
facts.excerpt: A rare rock beach and vast natural beaches are just a short drive from the resort. You can watch waves crash against the rocks for a relaxing stroll and sink your toes into the sand by arranging your transportation with our concierge.

facts.text: Grassy Waters Preserve, a wetlands ecosystem with a taste of the Everglades, is 10 minutes from the resort.
facts.excerpt: Get a taste of the Everglades just 10 minutes from PGA National. This 23-square-mile wetlands ecosystem in West Palm Beach

facts.text: The resort is at 450 Avenue of the Champions in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida.
facts.excerpt:
450 Avenue of the Champions

Palm Beach Gardens, FL 33418

facts.text: The Butcher's Club, a steakhouse from Florida native chef Jeremy Ford, is a 2025 and 2026 Michelin-recommended restaurant.
facts.excerpt: Stylish and modern elegance awaits you at The Butcher’s Club, our 2025 and 2026 Michelin-recommended restaurant. Expect unforgettable culinary experiences at this modern steakhouse from Florida native Jeremy Ford

facts.text: Honeybelle is a seasonal American restaurant led by chef Lindsay Autry that uses honey sourced from the resort's own property.
facts.excerpt: each dish reflects a commitment to regional flavors, from Florida citrus-infused cocktails to honey sourced from our own property.

facts.text: The resort has undergone a $100 million transformation.
facts.excerpt: Discover our stunning $100 million resort transformation including the expansive 40,000 sq ft reimagined spa

facts.text: The resort's golf offering totals 99 holes, including two new courses, The Match and The Staple 9-hole.
facts.excerpt: adding a few surprises including two new courses — The Match and The Staple 9-hole — for a total of 99 holes

facts.text: PGA National Members Club features 79 holes of golf.
facts.excerpt: PGA National Members Club features 79 holes of world-class golf

facts.text: The Champion is a must-play on any avid golfer's list.
facts.excerpt: The Champion is a must-play on any avid golfer’s list
